fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description:
Default - a grid of cards.
Carousel - auto-rotates; recommended: 6 to 12 cards.
Timeline - 6 to 10 cards.
Pillars - up to 6 cards, JPG or PNG images only.
Roller - 3 to 6 cards, one per scroll step.
Rail - a horizontally scrolling row of fixed-width cards, any number.
Features - cards that open their details in a pop-up, with a Next button to the next card. Image cards (Technology, Safety): the picture fills the card, with its title and short line; the rest of its text shows in the pop-up. Stat tiles (Performance): the title in bold (e.g. 590 Nm) and a short label, the picture shown in the pop-up; up to 4 across on desktop and 2 x 2 on phones, more scroll sideways. Card text: see the card's Text field.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Pillars: 1. Label 2. Heading 3. Description, opening words in bold. Timeline: 1. Title as a heading, 2. Description 3. Location in italics. Roller: 1. Title as a heading 2. Description. Carousel in a Light section: 1. Label 2. Title as a heading 3. Description 4. Link. Features: 1. Title as a heading (or in bold for a stat tile, e.g. 590 Nm) 2. Short line 3. and on: the detail, shown with the image when the card is opened (a heading first is the detail title).
